A working Zetaris join for "Which Montgomery tracts had the biggest increase in code violations from 2024 to 2025?": WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2024,
         SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS code_violations_2025
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = '<run_id>' AND source = 'm1_city' AND geoid IS NOT NULL AND value_kind = 'count'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name,
       (COALESCE(y.code_violations_2025, 0) - COALESCE(y.code_violations_2024, 0)) AS increase_in_code_violations,
       COALESCE(y.code_violations_2024, 0) AS code_violations_2024,
       COALESCE(y.code_violations_2025, 0) AS code_violations_2025,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN yearly y ON t.geoid = y.geoid
ORDER BY increase_in_code_violations DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200

A working Zetaris join for "Which Montgomery census tracts have the highest adult asthma rates, and how many code violations were reported in each this year?": SELECT t.name AS tract_name, t.geoid, CAST(c.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_rate, CAST(c.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS total_population, COALESCE(v.n, 0) AS code_violations_2026 FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t LEFT JOIN session.fw_<run>_m1_cdc AS c ON c.tractfips = t.geoid LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS v ON v.geoid = t.geoid AND v.run_id = '<run_id>' AND v.source = 'm2_city' AND v.grp = 'all' WHERE c.casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL ORDER BY adult_asthma_rate DESC LIMIT 50
